title: Plan moving our own dedicated sites onto the standard system
description: What: order and risks for moving our own sites. Threat Intelligence goes first and onto the shared multi-tenant stack as tenant #1 (after the brand-neutral acceptance test and real tenant authorisation). Shipped, Anth.us and Machines on Machines stay dedicated for now; Pilobolus and Papyrus-web are not yet decided. Open question for Ryan: Distinctive Mark is dedicated pending its upgrade; shared or dedicated afterwards is not decided. Planning only; no work until the layout and shared stack are proven.
